args.body: Take SQLITE-RELATED-TOOLS-REFERRAL if unfinished and no equivalent assessment already exists. Check the queued capture receipt before any follow-up. A directory listing is useful only if the existing diagnostic fits and there is a documented way for the operator to propose it. Use the live intake and verified worked example. Keep referral visibility, eligible inquiry, paid acceptance and settlement separate.

description: The live SQLite page already offers case-specific diagnosis in English and French, so the next test is whether a relevant directory can bring developers to the existing intake. Toronto’s screen covered 10 titles and no original notices. Reconsider that procurement route when a readable notice specifies paid scope and measurable acceptance. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
